messages:
lina: Heads-up — p99 for /v1/generate spiked in the latency dashboard around 13:12 UTC but the raw tdigest rollups show no corresponding tail. dashboard looks like it aggregated something wrong :thinking_face:
andrew: Hmm. Are you sure the query is scoped to the same label keys? the dashboard groups by `slice` + `endpoint` while ingestion recently added `route` label. could be a key mismatch causing bad rollups.
lina: Good call. dashboard panel query: `SELECT quantile(0.99, td) AS p99 FROM tdigest_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND slice='rest' GROUP BY time(1m)` — that returned a spike. but when I run raw `endpoint`-only query the spike disappears.
kevin: That screams label cardinality / rollup key mismatch. If some samples were ingested with `endpoint='/v1/generate'` and others with `route='/generate'`, the rollup tdigests would be split and then the dashboard's grouping could accidentally pick a small-sample tdigest with high p99.
maya: I noticed router metadata enrichment change in the last deploy — we started emitting `route` and stopped emitting `slice` for a subset of paths during canary 12:05–13:00. deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-12T12:04:32Z to service/router v2.7.1 rolled out to canary hosts.
sre-bot: alert: high-p99-delta detected for service=platform-dashboard route=/v1/generate window=13:10-13:20
lina: So dashboard grouping by `slice` + `endpoint` may have pulled a tiny partition of tdigest samples that had bad latency (maybe a single outlier request) and that produced the spike.
andrew: Right. Two mitigation ideas: 1) canonicalize labels at ingest (preferred) so rollups are consistent; 2) change dashboard to compute percentiles from a merged tdigest across all related keys (i.e., `merge_tdigest`) before quantile.
kevin: Option 2 is fast to ship as a dashboard change. Quick example:
```
SELECT quantile(0.99, merge_tdigest(td)) AS p99
FROM tdigest_rollups
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate'
GROUP BY time(1m)
```
That ignores `slice`/`route` splits.
maya: We should still fix router enrichment — otherwise downstream SLOs and billing metrics could be inconsistent. I'll open a rollback/patch to restore `slice` for canary hosts.
lina: I'll update the dashboard panel to use `merge_tdigest` and add a note in the description explaining why (and mark as temp).
andrew: Also add a small eval in the console UI: if a group has few samples (sample_count < 50) show a warning next to percentile selector. UX-wise users get alerted about low-sample percentiles.
kevin: +1 for low-sample warning. We should also audit historical rollups for orphaned labels. I can run a scan: `SELECT count(*) WHERE has(label.route) AND NOT has(label.slice)` and report counts by service.
maya: filed INFRA-1248 to revert enrichment on canary hosts and INFRA-1249 to add canonicalization at ingest. I'll link PRs in the ticket.
sre-bot: ticket INFRA-1248 created by maya — priority P2.
lina: Thanks — once dashboard change is in prod I'll re-check the p99 graph and post screenshots. :thumbsup:
